description: Add share entries (users and groups) to a data model.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the data model to add shares to.

shares.description: List of share definitions to add. Each dictionary should include: ``name`` (user email or group name), ``type`` (``"user"`` or ``"group"``), and ``permission`` (one of ``"EDIT"``, ``"READ"``, ``"USE"``).

examples.user_query: Share the 'SalesAnalytics' DataModel with the sales team and give them edit permissions.
examples.notes: This call adds a share entry for the 'SalesTeam' group to the 'SalesAnalytics' DataModel with edit permissions.

examples.user_query: Grant read access to the 'MarketingDashboard' DataModel for the user 'jdoe'.
examples.notes: This call adds a share entry for the user 'jdoe' to the 'MarketingDashboard' DataModel with read permissions.

examples.user_query: Allow the 'AnalyticsTeam' group to use the 'CustomerInsights' DataModel.
examples.notes: This call adds a share entry for the 'AnalyticsTeam' group to the 'CustomerInsights' DataModel with use permissions.

description: Retrieve all share entries (users and groups) for a given data model.

datamodel_name.description: Name of the data model to retrieve shares for.

examples.user_query: Who has access to the Sales DataModel?
examples.notes: Retrieves all users and groups that have access to the 'Sales' DataModel, along with their permissions.

examples.user_query: Can you list the shares for the MarketingAnalytics DataModel?
examples.notes: Fetches a detailed list of all share entries for the 'MarketingAnalytics' DataModel, including users and groups.

examples.user_query: I need to see who has permissions for the FinanceModel.
examples.notes: Provides a flat list of all parties (users and groups) with their permissions for the 'FinanceModel' DataModel.
